sourceScript.title: The Adventure Begins
sourceScript.activatedBy: Julian explicit no-pollen-bags direction, applied by Codex

orderedEvents.text: Open water. Endless blue. Keen sails confidently — or at least he tries to. The friendly DOLPHIN keeps pace beside the boat, popping up every so often.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Hi! I’m Keen! Nice to meet you, Squeaky!
The Dolphin chatters happily. Keen nods like that settles it.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Squeaky. Perfect. You really do sound squeaky.

beats.storyBeat: Open water makes Keen small, but he tries to sail confidently while Squeaky keeps pace. Naming Squeaky turns the dolphin from surprise into companion, and Keen’s misunderstanding of chirps is sweetly self-assured.
beats.want: Keen wants to make the open sea feel friendly and manageable.
beats.need: He needs companionship, even before he admits the scale scares him.
beats.kidRead: Keen sails with his new dolphin friend and gives him a perfect name.
beats.adultRead: The child fills uncertainty with chatter and friendship because silence would reveal how big the water is.
beats.emotionalIntent: Keep the surface playful while the wide sea quietly enlarges around him.

cuts.action: Open water. Endless blue. Keen sails confidently — or at least he tries to. The friendly DOLPHIN keeps pace beside the boat, popping up every so often.

cuts.speaker: Keen
cuts.exactText: Hi! I’m Keen! Nice to meet you, Squeaky!
cuts.dialogue: Keen: Hi! I’m Keen! Nice to meet you, Squeaky!

cuts.action: The Dolphin chatters happily. Keen nods like that settles it.

cuts.speaker: Keen
cuts.exactText: Squeaky. Perfect. You really do sound squeaky.
cuts.dialogue: Keen: Squeaky. Perfect. You really do sound squeaky.

orderedEvents.text: Squeaky leaps high beside the boat. Keen laughs. He looks at his map. Then ahead. Then back at his map. A little uncertain.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Okay… so if this is north… then I am definitely going…
He turns the map upside down.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: …one of the directions.

beats.storyBeat: The map turns from tool to comic threat. Keen tries to reason his way through directions, flips the map, and lands on uncertainty as a joke rather than a confession.
beats.want: Keen wants to prove he can navigate by himself.
beats.need: He needs to accept help before pride turns uncertainty into danger.
beats.kidRead: Keen gets confused by the map and turns it upside down.
beats.adultRead: His cover-up is still charming, but now the stakes are beginning to outgrow the joke.
beats.emotionalIntent: Use gentle map comedy to expose vulnerability without humiliating him.

cuts.action: Squeaky leaps high beside the boat. Keen laughs. He looks at his map. Then ahead. Then back at his map. A little uncertain.

cuts.speaker: Keen
cuts.exactText: Okay… so if this is north… then I am definitely going…
cuts.dialogue: Keen: Okay… so if this is north… then I am definitely going…

cuts.action: He turns the map upside down.

orderedEvents.text: A gust of wind hits. The sail FLAPS hard. The boat lurches. Keen stumbles sideways and grabs the mast.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Oh!

The sky darkens. Clouds roll in faster than he expected. Squeaky disappears beneath the water. Another gust. Stronger. Rain starts as a few drops. Then many. Then sheets. The sea roughens. The boat CREAKS. Keen tries to keep hold of the map while steering. The wind SNATCHES it from his paws.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: No no no no—!

beats.storyBeat: The first hard gust turns uncertainty into physical danger. The boat lurches, the sky darkens, Squeaky disappears, rain arrives in sheets, and the wind steals the map — Keen’s performed control is stripped away by the world.
beats.want: Keen wants to hold onto the boat, the map and the idea that he can still manage this.
beats.need: He needs to feel the fear honestly before a real decision can emerge.
beats.kidRead: The wind gets strong, rain pours, and the map flies away.
beats.adultRead: The symbols of independence — boat, map, command — fail all at once, leaving only the child inside the performance.
beats.emotionalIntent: Shift the episode into genuine jeopardy while keeping the action legible and not frightening beyond safe adventure.

cuts.action: A gust of wind hits. The sail FLAPS hard. The boat lurches. Keen stumbles sideways and grabs the mast.

The sky darkens. Clouds roll in faster than he expected. Squeaky disappears beneath the water. Another gust. Stronger. Rain starts as a few drops. Then many. Then sheets. The sea roughens. The boat CREAKS. Keen tries to keep hold of the map while steering. The wind SNATCHES it from his paws.

orderedEvents.text: He lunges for it. Misses. The map whips through the air and vanishes into the storm. Keen stands frozen. Rainwater sloshes around his feet. The horizon disappears behind sheets of grey.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Oh no… I’m lost!!!

beats.storyBeat: Keen misses the map and freezes as the horizon vanishes. His admission that he is lost lands as the first open crack in the brave mask.
beats.want: Keen wants the map back because it was his proof of control.
beats.need: He needs to admit that he does not know the way.
beats.kidRead: The map is gone, everything is grey, and Keen says he is lost.
beats.adultRead: The child’s first real helplessness arrives when there is no adult in frame to hand the answer back.
beats.emotionalIntent: Let fear land cleanly, with the storm swallowing geography around him.

cuts.action: He lunges for it. Misses. The map whips through the air and vanishes into the storm. Keen stands frozen. Rainwater sloshes around his feet. The horizon disappears behind sheets of grey.

orderedEvents.text: Lightning flickers far away. Keen grips the edge of the boat tighter. His breathing quickens. He closes his eyes for just a second. Breathes. Grounds himself.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: I’ve got this… I’ve got this…

beats.storyBeat: Keen grips the boat, breathes, grounds himself and repeats his brave phrase. It is not full courage yet; it is a small self-rescue, the attempt to keep from coming apart.
beats.want: Keen wants to steady himself enough to choose the next action.
beats.need: He needs to discover that bravery can begin as a shaky breath, not a fearless leap.
beats.kidRead: Keen holds on, closes his eyes, breathes and tells himself he can do it.
beats.adultRead: A child uses the phrase he has been using as performance and begins turning it into an actual foothold.
beats.emotionalIntent: Hold the panic just long enough for the audience to feel the first inward steadiness.

cuts.action: Lightning flickers far away. Keen grips the edge of the boat tighter. His breathing quickens. He closes his eyes for just a second. Breathes. Grounds himself.

cuts.speaker: Keen
cuts.exactText: I’ve got this… I’ve got this…
cuts.dialogue: Keen: I’ve got this… I’ve got this…

orderedEvents.text: A familiar CLICKING CHATTER sounds nearby. Keen opens his eyes. Squeaky leaps through the storm water beside the boat. He dips and reappears, signaling insistently in one direction.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Follow you?
Squeaky chirps. Keen looks at the rough water. Then at Squeaky. Then nods.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Okay… lead on, Squeaky!
Squeaky surges ahead. Keen wrestles the little boat around to follow.

beats.storyBeat: Squeaky returns through the storm, signaling a direction. Keen looks from rough water to his friend and decides to follow, choosing trust over solitary control.
beats.want: Keen wants a way through the storm.
beats.need: He needs to accept guidance from someone else without feeling smaller.
beats.kidRead: Squeaky shows him where to go, and Keen follows.
beats.adultRead: The lost child’s first real mature choice is not command but trust.
beats.emotionalIntent: Turn panic toward motion and hope, with Squeaky as connection rather than solution.

shots.purpose: Establish Keen trying to look confident in a huge empty seascape and turn Squeaky from surprise into companion.
shots.performanceAssignment: Keen rides the small boat left-to-right across open water with a lifted chest and quick balancing corrections; Squeaky keeps pace at screen-right, surfacing beside the boat between Keen’s looks. Keen raises one hand in greeting, speaks, listens to Squeaky’s chatter, then nods once as if the name is settled before delivering the second line.
shots.camera: Wide opening on endless water with the boat small in frame, camera on the starboard side looking across the boat toward screen-right travel; slow push to a medium two-shot as Squeaky pops up beside the hull, holding consistent left-to-right screen direction.
shots.openingPose: Keen stands center-left in the boat with one hand lightly on the tiller and the other beginning to lift; Squeaky is just below the surface at screen-right with ripples rising where the next pop-up will happen.
shots.visualPayoff: Squeaky chatters happily at screen-right, Keen nods toward Squeaky, and the boat continues left-to-right with Keen still balancing himself in the open water.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: Hi! I’m Keen! Nice to meet you, Squeaky!
dialogueLines.delivery: Bright greeting, slightly breathy from balancing on the boat; friendly and proud of the new name.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: Squeaky. Perfect. You really do sound squeaky.
dialogueLines.delivery: Satisfied and matter-of-fact, with a small nod on “Perfect.”

shots.purpose: Turn the map from a useful object into a comic problem while Keen tries to keep acting certain.
shots.performanceAssignment: Squeaky arcs up beside the boat and splashes down at screen-right. Keen laughs, then brings the map up from the boat, checks it, looks ahead over the bow, checks it again, and hesitates. During the first line he points at the map as if locating north. After the line, he rotates the map upside down with both hands, pauses, then says the final line while looking over the top edge of the map.
shots.camera: Continue from the previous two-shot; gentle drift into a medium shot on Keen with Squeaky still visible at screen-right during the leap, then a motivated push-in to the map in Keen’s hands as his attention drops to it.
shots.openingPose: Keen’s shoulders are lifted from the end of his pleased nod, one hand still on the tiller while his free hand starts down toward the folded map; Squeaky is coiling at the waterline for a leap at screen-right.
shots.visualPayoff: Keen holds the map upside down in front of him, peeks over it toward the water ahead, and lets the final words land while the boat continues left-to-right.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: Okay… so if this is north… then I am definitely going…
dialogueLines.delivery: Quiet reasoning aloud, slowing as the map stops helping.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Small, sheepish confidence; the pause before the line lets the upside-down map read first.

shots.purpose: Strip away Keen’s performed control as weather, boat movement, and the stolen map overpower him.
shots.performanceAssignment: A hard gust hits from screen-right. The sail snaps and flaps; the boat tilts left, then rocks back. Keen stumbles sideways, drops one hand from the map, and grabs the mast. He blurts the first line as his feet slide. Clouds roll in, the light drops, Squeaky slips below the surface and vanishes, rain begins as visible drops and quickly turns into sheets. Keen tries to steer with one hand and clamp the map with the other. A stronger gust yanks the map free; Keen’s fingers chase it as he calls out the second line.
shots.camera: Start in medium on Keen and the sail; when the gust hits, the camera jolts with the boat but keeps the same starboard-side geography. Internal move widens to include darkening sky, rougher water, and Squeaky’s disappearance, then tracks the map as it tears free toward screen-right and upward.
shots.openingPose: Keen stands center-left with both hands on the upside-down map at chest height, knees flexed; the sail is just beginning to pull hard from an incoming gust at screen-right, and Squeaky is still visible near the waterline.
shots.visualPayoff: The map is torn from Keen’s hands and whips upward toward screen-right into the rain while Keen releases the tiller and reaches after it from the rocking boat.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Short startled yelp on the first lurch.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Fast, panicked, cut off by the map whipping away.

shots.purpose: Let the loss of the map land, then reveal Keen’s first open admission that he is lost.
shots.performanceAssignment: Keen lunges from the same reach, stretching toward the airborne map. The boat drops under him; his hand closes on empty rain. The map spins away into the grey sheets and disappears. Keen lands with both feet apart, arms lowered and stiff. Water sloshes around his feet as the horizon vanishes behind rain. He holds still for a beat before speaking.
shots.camera: Matched-action continuation from Keen’s reach; medium-wide with the map crossing screen-right and out into the storm, then a slow tightening on Keen as the horizon disappears behind him.
shots.openingPose: Keen is pitched forward at center-left, one arm already extending toward the airborne map just ahead of his fingertips at screen-right; rain sheets across the frame and the boat is dropping into the next wave.
shots.visualPayoff: Keen stands frozen in the boat with empty hands, rainwater sloshing around his feet and no visible horizon beyond the sheets of grey rain.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Begins small on “Oh no,” then breaks into a frightened shout on “I’m lost.”

shots.purpose: Show Keen making a small self-rescue: grip, breathe, and repeat the brave phrase without fully solving the danger.
shots.performanceAssignment: A far lightning flicker flashes behind the rain. Keen’s hands lift from his frozen sides and clamp onto the boat edge. His breathing becomes quick and visible in his shoulders. He closes his eyes for one second, then takes a slower breath while keeping both hands locked on the edge. He speaks the line quietly through the rain as his shoulders lower a little.
shots.camera: Medium close on Keen at the boat edge, rain streaking foreground; the lightning flicker is distant and brief, with no cutaway. Camera stays on the same side and rides the boat’s rocking with a softer, steadier movement than the previous storm shot.
shots.openingPose: Keen stands frozen at center of the boat with arms lowered and fingers beginning to curl upward toward the edge as distant lightning starts to flicker behind the rain.
shots.visualPayoff: Keen remains gripping the boat edge with both hands, eyes closed, shoulders lower than before, rain still driving across him.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: I’ve got this… I’ve got this…
dialogueLines.delivery: Soft, shaky repetition with a breath between the two phrases.

shots.purpose: Bring Squeaky back as a trustworthy guide and have Keen choose to follow rather than handle the storm alone.
shots.performanceAssignment: A clicking chatter sounds nearby before Squeaky appears. Keen opens his eyes and turns toward screen-right. Squeaky leaps through the storm water beside the boat, dips under, then reappears farther ahead at screen-right, repeatedly angling his body and splashing toward a clear direction. Keen asks the first line while looking from Squeaky to the rough water ahead. Squeaky chirps. Keen looks at the water, back to Squeaky, nods once, then speaks the second line. Squeaky surges ahead and Keen hauls the tiller, bracing his feet as the boat pivots to follow screen-right.
shots.camera: Sound bridge from offscreen chatter into a medium on Keen opening his eyes; pan to include Squeaky’s leap at screen-right, then widen as Squeaky moves ahead and the boat turns after him. Camera remains on the starboard side and preserves Squeaky leading toward screen-right.
shots.openingPose: Keen is still gripping the boat edge with both hands, eyes closed and shoulders lowered; rain sheets across the frame as offscreen clicking begins near screen-right.
shots.visualPayoff: Squeaky pulls ahead at screen-right through the storm water while Keen braces in the boat and turns the tiller so the bow follows Squeaky’s path.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Questioning and cautious, pitched over the storm noise.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.delivery: Starts hesitant on “Okay,” then grows firmer and louder on the name.
